messages:
Elaine: Heads up — got a DSAR that also includes a request for "all logs and retained evidence related to incident-2025-03". They're asking for raw request/response logs that we usually purge after 90 days. Legal says we might need to preserve evidence for forensics. Need a quick sync on retention exception + KMS-snapshot access path.
Samir Patel: @Elaine can you paste the DSAR wording? if they request "all logs" that's broad — legal needs scope. We can negotiate redaction for PII. Also need to know if this is a court order or standard DSAR.
Elaine: Copy of request: "Pursuant to GDPR Art. 15, please provide all logs and evidence relating to user-id 0xabc123 and incident-2025-03 from Jan 2025 onwards." No court order.
Maya Ortiz: If no court order, we try to minimize. Suggest we offer anonymized metadata + timeline. Full raw logs only if necessary and with retention exception + legal signoff. :heavy_check_mark: 
Chris Nguyen: Technical: to prolong access we'll need to snapshot S3/KMS key rotation state. Current retention lifecycle deletes logs after 90d and S3 lifecycle moves to Glacier. For an exception we should: 1) create a retention-override ticket; 2) snapshot S3 prefix; 3) snapshot KMS key alias and export access policy to a sealed bucket; 4) update audit log to mark evidence retention.
Elaine: who can create the retention-override ticket? We need to keep these artifacts 12 more months pending legal.
Samir Patel: I can file the exception with Legal. Need product/ops confirmation we can snapshot without exposing other customer data.
Chris Nguyen: We'll create scoped snapshot: prefix filter by user-id and incident tag. Use this CLI, run by eng-sre with READ_ONLY on bucket:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/2025/incident-2025-03/ s3://redwood-dsar-evidence/1987654321/ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "*0xabc123*"
```
Then run `aws kms grant` to the evidence KMS key. I'll put exact commands in runbook.
Maya Ortiz: Also check embeddings/redis caches — may contain transient copies. We need a sweep for derived data. If derived embeddings exist, best practice is to delete and provide derived-report instead.
Audit Bot: NOTE: Created evidence-ticket EVID-2025-1987654321, assigned to eng-sre.
Elaine: Thanks. Samir/maya/chris — can you review the short playbook I'm drafting for this flow? I'll DM a link. Quick responses pls, request is EOD.
Samir Patel: On it.
Chris Nguyen: I'll add runbook steps and permissions.
Maya Ortiz: I'll draft privacy-safe response options.
Elaine: Filing the retention-exception request now. Will update thread when done. :memo:
